# Snitch

> Snitch is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), privacy-first real-time network
> traffic visualizer for macOS, Windows and Linux. It shows every connection
> your computer makes — which remote hosts, where they are located, and which
> local process is responsible — as a living node graph and world map.
> All analysis is 100% local: no telemetry, no cloud calls, offline GeoIP.
> Snitch est un visualiseur de trafic réseau en temps réel, gratuit,
> open-source et respectueux de la vie privée — interface entièrement
> bilingue anglais/français.

Snitch passively captures packets on the local machine (libpcap/Npcap),
enriches them locally (DNS answers, TLS SNI, reverse DNS, offline
DB-IP Lite geolocation, IEEE OUI vendor table), and renders a live D3.js
force graph plus an interactive world map. A privacy score rates the
outgoing traffic exposure in real time, and anomaly detection flags port
scans, beaconing and possible exfiltration.

## What it does

- Live force graph: your machine at the center, LAN devices inside a dashed
  perimeter ring, external hosts on an outer orbit
- Interactive world map with geolocated IPs and animated arcs (offline GeoIP
  — DB-IP Lite bundled, zero network calls)
- Anomaly detection: port scans, beaconing, exfiltration heuristics
- Process attribution: which app generates which traffic, per-app history
- Passive LAN discovery via the system ARP table (no broadcast scans)
- Privacy score, bandwidth sparkline, 15/30/60-min sliding timeline (SQLite,
  24 h retention), persisted alert-suppression rules
- Fully bilingual UI: English and French, one-click toggle

## Security model

- Loopback-only by default (127.0.0.1); token auth on every REST endpoint
  and the WebSocket; origin allowlist for CORS/WS
- No outbound calls at runtime except one explicitly consent-gated,
  optional DB-IP Lite update from the Settings panel
- Capture requires privileges: root/sudo on macOS (/dev/bpf) and Linux
  (cap_net_raw), Administrator + Npcap on Windows

## Tech stack

- Backend: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, WebSockets, SQLite, ctypes→libpcap
  (own IPv4/IPv6/TCP/UDP/DNS/TLS-SNI parser — no Scapy)
- Frontend: React 18, Vite, D3.js v7, TopoJSON
- Desktop: Electron 44 (Windows installer via electron-builder)
- Installable 1-click via Pinokio (launcher scripts at repo root)

## Compared to similar tools

- vs **Little Snitch / Lulu** (macOS firewalls): Snitch visualizes and
  explains traffic rather than blocking it; cross-platform, free,
  open-source
- vs **GlassWire**: free, open-source, no account, no cloud, offline GeoIP
- vs **Wireshark**: high-level live overview for non-specialists instead of
  raw packet dissection

## Français

Snitch visualise en temps réel tout le trafic réseau de votre machine :
graphe de nœuds vivant, carte du monde géolocalisée (GeoIP hors ligne),
score de confidentialité, détection d'anomalies, attribution par processus.
100 % local, sans télémétrie, bilingue EN/FR, open-source AGPL.
